BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4 is a fast-paced BRAZILIAN old school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, and using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). It is a standalone expansion of the hit boomer shooter BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT ! And It is A TRIBUTE TO THE BRAZILIAN MODS OF THE 2000S, THE BRAZILIAN BOOTLEG GAMES OF THE 2000S, BRAZILIAN MUSIC AND THE BEST BAND IN THE HISTORY OF BRAZIL, MAMADAS!

AFTER YOU SAVE MIT AIA, MACKIE JACKIE AND THE MAMADAS, YOU DO A PARTY IN HEAVEN! BUT THINGS TOOK A BAD TURN WHEN THE MAMADAS WERE KIDNAPPNED BY RONALDO MCDALEST! SAVE THEM FROM RONALDO, AND SAVE THEIR GLOBECETA PORTAL OPENER CAR TOO! RONALDO STILL HAS SOME DEMONS FROM THE INVASION AROUND! END THE REMAINING DEMONS AND SAVE RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO AND SALVADOR!

  • A BUNCH OF ENEMIES GOING FROM ARMED DEMONS TO ZOMBIES, BRAZILIAN TRUCK CLOWNS AND EVEN POSSESSED BRAZILIAN SINGERS! ALSO NEW ENEMIES LIKE TWO DUDES IN A MOTORCYCLE, ANGRY TV MOUSES, AND POSSESSED SOCCER TEAM MASCOTS!

  • 18 CAMPAIGN STAGES GOING THROUGH THE ENTIRE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, PARTS OF SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE RIO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR AND SAVE THE MAMADAS!
